    const mainImg = container.querySelector('#ab-main-img');
    const thumbWraps = container.querySelectorAll('.ab-thumb-wrap');
    
    if(mainImg && thumbWraps.length > 0) {
        thumbWraps.forEach(wrap => {
            wrap.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const clickedImg = this.querySelector('.ab-thumb');
                if(!clickedImg) return;
                mainImg.style.opacity = 0.5;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    mainImg.src = clickedImg.src;
                    mainImg.style.opacity = 1;
                }, 150);
                container.querySelectorAll('.ab-thumb').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                clickedImg.classList.add('active');
                wrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
            });
        });
    }

    const AB_PHONE = "917012761588"; 
    let currentMaxCapacity = 56;
    let adults = 28, kids = 0;

    function calculatePriceDetails(packageId, adultCount) {
        let base = 0;
        let extra = 0;
        if (packageId === 'overnight') {
            base = 84000;
            if (adultCount > 28) extra = (adultCount - 28) * 1000;
        } else if (packageId === 'day') {
            base = 56000;
            if (adultCount > 56) extra = (adultCount - 56) * 800;
        } else if (packageId === 'night') {
            base = 63000;
            if (adultCount > 28) extra = (adultCount - 28) * 500;
        }
        let total = base + extra;
        return {
            base: base,
            extra: extra,
            total: total,
            formattedTotal: total.toLocaleString('en-IN')
        };
    }

    const termsData = {
        overnight: [
            "<strong>Itinerary & Menu Variations:</strong> The cruise route and food menu are subject to slight changes depending on the specific boat assigned, weather conditions, or seasonal availability.",
            "<strong>Check in:</strong> 12 noon. <strong>Check out:</strong> 09:00 AM.",
            "Guests are not allowed to sleep outside the bedrooms for safety reasons.",
            "Beverages and any cook-to-order items will be charged extra on actuals.",
            "Air conditioners in the bedrooms will be switched on only from 09:00 PM to 06:00 AM. If you require full-time AC, please inform us at the time of booking (extra charges apply).",
            "Meal plan applied on APAI / full board basis (inclusive of breakfast, lunch & dinner).",
            "Management is not responsible for late arrivals. Check-out time will be followed strictly as per schedule.",
            "You can enjoy complete privacy in the boat; it is exclusively booked for your group.",
            "The boat will be anchored in a designated backwater area during the night and will not cruise after 17:30 hrs."
        ],
        day: [
            "<strong>Itinerary & Menu Variations:</strong> The cruise route and food menu are subject to slight changes depending on the specific boat assigned, weather conditions, or seasonal availability.",
            "<strong>Check in:</strong> 11:30 AM. <strong>Check out:</strong> 5:00 PM.",
            "Guests are not allowed to sleep outside the bedrooms for safety reasons.",
            "Beverages and any cook-to-order items will be charged extra on actuals.",
            "Air conditioners in the bedrooms will be switched on only from 09:00 PM to 06:00 AM. If you require full-time AC, please inform us at the time of booking (extra charges apply).",
            "Management is not responsible for late arrivals. Check-out time will be followed strictly as per schedule.",
            "You can enjoy complete privacy in the boat; it is exclusively booked for your group."
        ],
        night: [
            "<strong>Itinerary & Menu Variations:</strong> The cruise route and food menu are subject to slight changes depending on the specific boat assigned, weather conditions, or seasonal availability.",
            "<strong>Check in:</strong> 5:00 PM. <strong>Check out:</strong> 09:00 AM.",
            "Guests are not allowed to sleep outside the bedrooms for safety reasons.",
            "Beverages and any cook-to-order items will be charged extra on actuals.",
            "Air conditioners in the bedrooms will be switched on only from 09:00 PM to 06:00 AM. If you require full-time AC, please inform us at the time of booking (extra charges apply).",
            "Management is not responsible for late arrivals. Check-out time will be followed strictly as per schedule.",
            "You can enjoy complete privacy in the boat; it is exclusively booked for your group."
        ]
    };

    const priceAmountDisplay = container.querySelector('.ab-sh-price-amount');
    const mobilePriceDisplay = container.querySelector('.ab-msb-price strong');
    const customSelectWrapper = container.querySelector('.ab-custom-select-wrapper');
    const customSelectTrigger = container.querySelector('#custom-select-trigger');
    const customSelectOptions = container.querySelectorAll('.ab-cso-item');
    const vAdults = container.querySelector('#val-adults');
    const vKids = container.querySelector('#val-kids');
    const btnAm = container.querySelector('#btn-adult-minus');
    const btnAp = container.querySelector('#btn-adult-plus');
    const btnKm = container.querySelector('#btn-kid-minus');
    const btnKp = container.querySelector('#btn-kid-plus');
    const dInput = container.querySelector('#ab-date');
    const waLinks = container.querySelectorAll('a.ab-btn-wa');

    function getSelectedPackage() {
        const activeOption = container.querySelector('.ab-cso-item.selected');
        return activeOption ? activeOption.dataset.value : 'overnight';
    }

    function setCruisePackage(packageId, shouldScroll = true) {
        if(customSelectOptions.length > 0) {
            customSelectOptions.forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('selected'));
            const activeOption = container.querySelector(`.ab-cso-item[data-value="${packageId}"]`);
            if(activeOption) {
                activeOption.classList.add('selected');
                const triggerTitle = container.querySelector('.ab-cst-title');
                const triggerSubtitle = container.querySelector('.ab-cst-subtitle');
                if(triggerTitle) triggerTitle.textContent = activeOption.querySelector('.ab-cso-title-text').textContent;
                if(triggerSubtitle) triggerSubtitle.textContent = activeOption.querySelector('.ab-cso-subtitle').textContent;
            }
        }
        const nativeSelect = container.querySelector('#ab-cruise-type');
        if(nativeSelect) nativeSelect.value = packageId;

        container.querySelectorAll('.ab-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        container.querySelectorAll('.ab-tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        
        const targetTabBtn = container.querySelector(`.ab-tab-btn[data-target="tab-${packageId}"]`);
        const targetTabContent = container.querySelector(`#tab-${packageId}`);
        if(targetTabBtn) {
            targetTabBtn.classList.add('active');
            if(shouldScroll) {
                targetTabBtn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
            }
        }
        if(targetTabContent) targetTabContent.classList.add('active');

        currentMaxCapacity = (packageId === 'day') ? 200 : 56;
        
        if (adults + kids > currentMaxCapacity) {
            adults = Math.min(adults, currentMaxCapacity);
            kids = Math.min(kids, currentMaxCapacity - adults);
            if (adults < 1) adults = 1;
        }

        const capacityNoteText = container.querySelector('.ab-capacity-note');
        if(capacityNoteText) {
            capacityNoteText.innerHTML = `<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" role="presentation"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"></line></svg> Maximum capacity is ${currentMaxCapacity} guests total.`;
        }
        const priceSubtitle = container.querySelector('.ab-sh-price-subtitle');
        if(priceSubtitle) priceSubtitle.textContent = `Whole boat • 14 bedroom luxury houseboat • Up to ${currentMaxCapacity} guests`;
        
        const headerCapacity = container.querySelector('#ab-header-capacity');
        if (headerCapacity) {
            headerCapacity.innerHTML = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" role="presentation"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path></svg> Up to ${currentMaxCapacity} Guests`;
        }

        const tcGrid = container.querySelector('#ab-tc-dynamic-grid');
        if(tcGrid && termsData[packageId]) {
            tcGrid.innerHTML = termsData[packageId].map(text => `
                <div class="ab-tc-item">
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" role="presentation"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"></path></svg>
                    <p>${text}</p>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
        syncUI();
    }

    function refreshPricing() {
        const pkg = getSelectedPackage();
        const pricing = calculatePriceDetails(pkg, adults);
        
        if(priceAmountDisplay) priceAmountDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="ab-price-from">From</span> ₹${pricing.formattedTotal}`;
        if(mobilePriceDisplay) mobilePriceDisplay.textContent = `₹${pricing.formattedTotal}`;
        
        const pbBase = document.getElementById('ab-pb-base');
        const pbExtra = document.getElementById('ab-pb-extra');
        const pbTotal = document.getElementById('ab-pb-total');
        const pbTotalFooter = document.getElementById('ab-pb-total-footer');
        const pbExtraRow = document.getElementById('ab-pb-extra-row');
        const pbBaseLabel = document.getElementById('ab-pb-base-label');

        if(pbBase) {
            pbBase.textContent = `₹${pricing.base.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
            pbTotal.textContent = `₹${pricing.formattedTotal}`;
            if(pbTotalFooter) pbTotalFooter.textContent = `₹${pricing.formattedTotal}`;
            
            let baseGuests = (pkg === 'day') ? 56 : 28;
            if(pbBaseLabel) pbBaseLabel.innerHTML = `Base Price <span style="font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #9ca3af; margin-left: 4px;">(Up to ${baseGuests} guests)</span>`;

            if(pricing.extra > 0) {
                pbExtraRow.style.display = 'flex';
                pbExtra.textContent = `+ ₹${pricing.extra.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
            } else {
                pbExtraRow.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        updateLink(pricing.formattedTotal);
    }

    if(customSelectTrigger && customSelectWrapper) {
        customSelectTrigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            customSelectWrapper.classList.toggle('open');
        });
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (!customSelectWrapper.contains(e.target)) {
                customSelectWrapper.classList.remove('open');
            }
        });
        customSelectOptions.forEach(option => {
            option.addEventListener('click', function() {
                setCruisePackage(this.dataset.value, false);
                customSelectWrapper.classList.remove('open');
            });
        });
    }

    const tabBtns = container.querySelectorAll('.ab-tab-btn');
    if(tabBtns.length > 0) {
        tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const targetPackage = btn.dataset.target.replace('tab-', '');
                setCruisePackage(targetPackage, true);
            });
        });
    }

    const stickyBtn = document.getElementById('ab-sticky-scroll-btn'); 
    const stickyBar = document.querySelector('.ab-mobile-sticky-bar');
    const bookingWidget = document.getElementById('booking-widget');

    if (stickyBar && bookingWidget) {
        let isWidgetVisible = false;
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                isWidgetVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
                toggleStickyBar();
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.1 }); 
        observer.observe(bookingWidget);

        function toggleStickyBar() {
            if (isWidgetVisible || window.scrollY < 350) {
                stickyBar.classList.add('ab-hide-bar');
            } else {
                stickyBar.classList.remove('ab-hide-bar');
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('scroll', toggleStickyBar, { passive: true });
        toggleStickyBar(); 
    }

    function initFlatpickr() {
        if (window.flatpickr && dInput) {
            window.flatpickr(dInput, { minDate: 'today', dateFormat: 'j M Y', disableMobile: true, onChange: refreshPricing });
        } else {
            setTimeout(initFlatpickr, 100);
        }
    }
    initFlatpickr();

    if (stickyBtn && bookingWidget) {
        stickyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const headerOffset = 80;
            const elementPosition = bookingWidget.getBoundingClientRect().top;
            const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.pageYOffset - headerOffset;
            window.scrollTo({ top: offsetPosition, behavior: "smooth" });
            setTimeout(() => {
                if(window.flatpickr && dInput._flatpickr) dInput._flatpickr.open();
            }, 600);
        });
    }

    function syncUI() {
        if(vAdults) vAdults.value = adults;
        if(vKids) vKids.value = kids;
        const total = adults + kids;
        if(btnAm) btnAm.disabled = (adults <= 1);
        if(btnKm) btnKm.disabled = (kids <= 0);
        if(btnAp) btnAp.disabled = (adults >= currentMaxCapacity || total >= currentMaxCapacity);
        if(btnKp) btnKp.disabled = (kids >= currentMaxCapacity || total >= currentMaxCapacity);
        refreshPricing();
    }

    if(vAdults) {
        vAdults.addEventListener('input', function() {
            let val = parseInt(this.value);
            if (isNaN(val)) return; 
            if (val < 1) val = 1;
            if (val > currentMaxCapacity) val = currentMaxCapacity;
            if (val + kids > currentMaxCapacity) val = currentMaxCapacity - kids;
            adults = val;
            refreshPricing();
        });
        vAdults.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            let val = parseInt(this.value);
            if (isNaN(val) || val < 1) val = 1;
            adults = val;
            syncUI();
        });
    }

    if(vKids) {
        vKids.addEventListener('input', function() {
            let val = parseInt(this.value);
            if (isNaN(val)) return; 
            if (val < 0) val = 0;
            if (val > currentMaxCapacity) val = currentMaxCapacity;
            if (adults + val > currentMaxCapacity) val = currentMaxCapacity - adults;
            kids = val;
            refreshPricing();
        });
        vKids.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            let val = parseInt(this.value);
            if (isNaN(val) || val < 0) val = 0;
            kids = val;
            syncUI();
        });
    }

    if(btnAp) btnAp.addEventListener('click', function() { if(adults < currentMaxCapacity && (adults + kids) < currentMaxCapacity) { adults++; syncUI(); } });
    if(btnAm) btnAm.addEventListener('click', function() { if(adults > 1) { adults--; syncUI(); } });
    if(btnKp) btnKp.addEventListener('click', function() { if(kids < currentMaxCapacity && (adults + kids) < currentMaxCapacity) { kids++; syncUI(); } });
    if(btnKm) btnKm.addEventListener('click', function() { if(kids > 0) { kids--; syncUI(); } });

    function updateLink(price) {
        if(waLinks.length === 0) return;
        let date = dInput ? (dInput.value || "Not Selected") : "Not Selected";
        let packageSelected = "Overnight Cruise";
        
        const activePkg = container.querySelector('.ab-cso-item.selected .ab-cso-title-text');
        if (activePkg) packageSelected = activePkg.textContent.trim(); 
        
        const msg = `Hi Alleppey Booking! I would like to check availability for a 14 Bedroom Houseboat Alleppey.\n\n*Package:* ${packageSelected}\n*Check-in Date:* ${date}\n*Guests:* ${adults} Adults, ${kids} Kids\n*Estimated Price:* ₹${price}\n\nPlease confirm availability.`;
        const finalHref = "https://wa.me/" + AB_PHONE + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(msg);
        
        waLinks.forEach(link => link.href = finalHref);
    }
    
    syncUI();
})();
</script>
